description: Read the Agoda price for one hotel (agoda_hotel_id from search_hotels) and one stay right now: total for the whole stay with taxes and fees, 2 adults, standard rate, plus room type and breakfast when Agoda reports them. A one-time reading — nothing is tracked or stored about the request. Used after booking elsewhere to see whether Agoda is now cheaper (input for check_refund_claim), or to compare a quoted price. agoda_url is a plain Agoda link for the same stay, suitable as evidence. Readings are cached for 30 minutes; live lookups share a daily budget.

check_out.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD (stay of 30 nights or less).

currency.description: ISO currency: KRW, JPY, USD, EUR, TWD, HKD, CNY, SGD, THB, GBP, AUD or VND (default USD). Use the currency the booking was paid in.

name: get_current_price
title: Read the current Agoda price for a stay
